name: IsEdgeFamily.exists_adjoint_first_arrow
summary: The kernel of the opposite space is a constant multiple of the conjugate kernel (`exists_modKernel_neg_left`), and the Petersson product of descents is given by `petersson_descent_eq`; Ψ′ = c·conj(κ)·(that datum).

steps.claim: Given the second family h′: the kernel of the pair (S.neg, T) is c times the conjugate of that of (S, T) (`exists_modKernel_neg_left`), and the Petersson product with a descent is κ times an integral of the kernel (`IsEdgeFamily.petersson_descent_eq`, K); take Ψ′ = c·conj(κ)·(the datum of K) and compare, for all y and x, after moving formNegEquiv to the other side: the inner product is a Petersson product (`Space.inner_eq_petersson`), the lift through the arrow of h (`IsArrow.coe_formLift`), and the integral over the opposite group is the pulled-back integral (`isForm_neg_iff_and_integral_neg`).
steps.lean:
fun h' ↦ by
  obtain ⟨⟨c, _⟩, κ, K⟩ := exists_modKernel_neg_left S T, h'.petersson_descent_eq _
  exact ⟨c • conj κ • _, (reindex_equiv (formNegEquiv ..).symm).1.2 fun y x ↦ by
  simp [modDescent, modDatum, Pi.smul_comp]
  erw [← star_inj, mul_comm, mul_comm _ κ, ← K, inner_eq_petersson,
    h.isArrow_modDatum.1.coe_formLift]; simp_all [modKernel, pairTheta, Space.lift, Space.petersson,
    ← integral_conj, mul_assoc, isForm_neg_iff_and_integral_neg S S.neg, mul_left_comm _ c]; tauto⟩
